notes.title: Update 0.8.0 - Tradingcards & Singleplayer
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403154/a71f93850e633cecd0fc163eb6145bb5ef1f34e9.png[/img]

Hey everyone. 

A while has passed since the last update. 
[b]That's why there are two of them this time![/b]

[h1]Singleplayer[/h1]

You are at home alone and want to play a round of Super Dashmatch?

No problem anymore!

We have added a singleplayer mode with the 0.8.0 Patch.
Go on a highscore hunt and train the different stages!
Kill as many dummy players as you can, but be careful - you only have a few lives.

The training will pay off at the next Dashmatch with your friends!

[h1]Tradingcards[/h1]

Now also with Super Dashmatch!
Collect trading cards and make badges to improve your steam level!


Thank you for your feedback and support.
Have fun with SDM!

Berlin Games Club & hOSHI*

notes.title: Update 0.6.5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403154/cd471f73d72ce0baa9fdf59454e0c2b0f40770ca.png[/img]

Hey everyone. 

We just released a small update that includes some bugfixes and user feedback we received since release.

[list]
[*]The player movement is now set to zero when the round ends
[*]When selecting a random stage you won't play the previous stage again
[*]You now can jump in a direction when spawning
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes freeze when a player gives input after the round has ended
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes freeze when a player activates a trigger
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes freeze when restarting a round
[*]Fixed a bug where the HoloCube-Crusher won't kill the player
[*]Fixed a bug where the player can fall through the FutureCube-Roaster-Stage
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and support.
Have fun with SDM!

Berlin Games Club & hOSHI*
